name: Three Five Two
overview: After his death, the elder son of the Suri family, Mashallah Khan, gives all his wealth to his nephew, Heshmat Suri, and Heshmat and his family, who previously lived an ordinary life and worked as fruit sellers, decide to make a big change in the family by buying a football club. In this situation, Heshmat Khan gets involved with many football brokers and events occur that are all related to current football issues and involve all family members in some way.
